messages.subject: Error when running BSM in a different machine/path
messages.subject_clean: Error when running BSM in a different machine/path
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

This is a minor inconvenience, but I would like to know if there is a way to resolve it.

I initially ran the standard BioGeoBEARS script on a Windows machine and then attempted to run BSMs on macOS. However, when executing 'get_inputs_for_stochastic_mapping(res=res)', R was unable to locate the tree because it is internally linked to the file path used in the original run.

Is there a way to update this path so that the function can locate the tree in the new environment?

Best regards,
Yago
